claims.evidence: No capacity label or model plate is legible in the photo; capacity cannot be confirmed remotely.
No rating plate or spec sticker showing voltage range is visible in the photo.
Photo 0 shows a blue sticker explicitly stating '120 HOURS COOLING RETENTION'.
Report notes power-on and cooling function are not shown; no video or plugged-in test photo provided.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may not cool effectively despite the warranty sticker.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the freezer plugged in, powering on, and the interior reaching cold temperature after some minutes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working / for-parts until functional proof is given

risks.risk: Interior condition (baskets, shelves, rust, odor) and lid gasket seal integrity are unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the open interior and close-up of the gasket seal all around the lid.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming worn interior and possible seal leakage

risks.risk: Compressor condition and noise level are unverified; staining near the compressor could indicate past leakage or repair.
risks.proof: A short video/audio clip of the compressor running, and a close-up photo of the compressor unit and any oil stains.
risks.if_unproven: priced as compressor of uncertain health, worst case near end-of-life

risks.risk: Underside and rear panel condition (rust, dents, missing feet) not visible.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear and underside of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible hidden rust or structural damage

risks.risk: Actual capacity and age/usage history cannot be confirmed from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating/model plate showing capacity, model number, and manufacture date.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower bound of typical chest freezer capacities for this size class

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing cooling after 10-15 minutes.
Close-up photo of the rating/model plate (capacity, voltage, model, serial).
Photos of the open interior, including baskets and gasket seal.
Photos of the rear and underside of the unit.
Audio/video clip of compressor operation noise.
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a chest freezer with a visible cooling-retention claim, but power function, interior condition, and capacity are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
